name: Media Vote
overview: Let your users vote on which movies and shows to remove.
description: An administrator calls a vote among selected Jellyfin users. Users vote from a banner at the top of their home page, a Vote tab (Custom Tabs), a sidebar page (Plugin Pages) or a standalone page. At the deadline the top N titles are either reported to the admin (default) or deleted with their files by Sonarr (series) or Radarr (movies). Media Vote itself never deletes or changes a media file.

versions.changelog: 1.1.0.0. A much easier vote builder. One shared media browser for the admin's hand-pick step and for voters (grid/list; size, drive and its fullness, who watched it last and when, plays, viewers, date added, removable by Sonarr/Radarr; filters, sorts and paging on the server; select all in a filter and a tray with per-drive totals). Deadline picker with quick choices, a flexible "in N days at HH:MM" row and a plain-words result worked out by the server (correct across clock changes). Drive detection with usage bars, names and warning levels; Storage and History tabs; free-space target; approval step before Sonarr/Radarr delete anything (on by default, optional auto-approve); presets; tie-break rules; templates and recurring drafts; results with sizes and a "Request it again" link; webhook extras. All 1.0.2.0 safety rules are unchanged. Requires Jellyfin 10.11.10.

1.0.2.0. Deletion now goes only through Sonarr and Radarr: Media Vote never deletes, moves or changes a media file (Jellyfin cannot write to exFAT drives). "Delete automatically" became "Delete via Sonarr/Radarr": winners are matched by provider ids, deleted with deleteFiles=true, verified gone, and Jellyfin forgets them once their files are gone. Several Sonarr/Radarr/Jellyseerr instances; titles they do not manage are marked and left out of delete votes by default; read-only dry run with the exact entries and GB; maximum titles per vote; Sonarr/Radarr state on the Status tab. Fixes the vote-results banner coming back after it was closed. Requires Jellyfin 10.11.10.
